summary: Election petition rejection application dismissed; Order VII Rule 11 CPC applicability; analysis of Section 33A R.P. Act 1951; non-disclosure of criminal cases; conviction under labour laws not triggering disqualification; pending cases disclosure requirement; certified copies of orders relied upon; no mini-trial permissible at Order VII Rule 11 stage; abuse of process claims; final disposal

final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding election petition validity upheld; impugned order set aside;
